page: Amazon Web Services c8id.24xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor and an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor. This x86_64 architecture system features 96 vCPUs across 48 physical cores with a 3.9 GHz clock speed and a 480 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 192 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, providing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio.

The instance includes 5700 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, offering high-capacity, low-latency instance store volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 40 Gbps. No dedicated GPUs are present on this configuration.

In benchmark evaluations, the c8id.24xlarge demonstrates top-tier performance. It achieves top 10% placement in Passmark CPU tests, Geekbench multi-core scores, and software compilation tasks. The processor's advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel AMX, contribute to strong performance in cryptographic operations and LLM prompt processing. Memory bandwidth for small cached blocks also ranks in the top 10%, though the overall Passmark memory score falls in the average tier.

Given its high compute density, fast DDR5 memory, and large local NVMe storage, this instance is highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring intensive CPU processing paired with rapid local disk access. It is well-suited for high-throughput database operations, Redis deployments, static web serving, software compilation, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
